nom: bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser

avis.texte: I loved the pure plush cleanser and used it for years. My skin is so sensitive and it's one of the only products that didn't make it angry. Of course, bare minerals decides to get rid of it and replace it with this watered down, not foaming at all cleanser. It still works fine for my skin but I miss the old cleanser. They say this one foams..I've gone thru at least three so far and only one wasn't completely watery and slightly gave some bubbles. Quit changing good formulas! UGH.

I previously used and LOVED the bareMinerals Pure Plush Foaming Cleanser - it had an amazing texture and a small amount foamed up beautifully, left my face so clean and refreshed. For some reason they discontinued the Pure Plush and, as a brand loyalist, this was the closest replacement I could find.. DOES NOT COMPARE. The Cushion Cloud has an okay smell, a bit medicinal but it's fine, but the lather is absolute garbage - have to use twice as much to get a thin layer of bubbles that I'd hardly call a lather. This product feels like a scam - I now believe bareMinerals is like every other greedy business and wants folks to pay the same but use twice as much to fuel more frequent purchasing. I no longer hype this brand like I once did, it now feels overpriced and underwhelming. Bad choice, guys.

I absolutely love this facial cleanser! It cleans my skin thoroughly while leaving my skin baby soft after rinsing it off. I have not found another cleanser in the market that leaves my skin feeling this soft. My new fav!
This cleanser has been my new favorite go-to. It has been very good on my sensitive, acne prone skin. The scent is very light and clean.

I'm not sure that the consistency is right! It is so runny! Not what I expected. There is nothing cushiony or cloudy about it. ? I purchased because of the great reviews and now I'm just confused about it.
why do companies always do this?? a popular, loved product rebranded reformulated and turned to garbage. taking my money elsewhere. so sad
Changed formula. Used old one for years and loved it. This new one is mostly air. Didn't last as long as the old formula. Will not buy again.

avis.titre: If it's not broke don't fix it
avis.texte: I used the pure plush cleanser for years and was sad when I went to reorder it and found it was being discontinued. Now they rebranded and it is completely different. There's no suds, it feels like lotion and leaves a residue. Bring back the old one.
I love this cleanser is so gentle on my sensitive skin and it cleanses very well. I use it morning and night, because it doesn't irritate me.

For somewhere has eczema and extremely dry and sensitive skin, this face wash is so soft and gentle on my skin without sacrificing the perfect wash. My face feels cool and refreshed all day long. It remi ds me of a lighter version of Noxema without the smell. I like it!

I received this product in exchange for my honesty review. I have used the product every morning for 30 days. This is a great cleanser does not dry your skin out. Leave your face feeling smooth. I would definitely purchase again. The only thing I would change about this product is the packaging does kind of come out fast so therefore I feel like I'm wasting product.

I received this product for free from @Bzzagent and @BareMinerals to try out and review for my unbiased opinion. Firstly, I like the packaging of the cleanser and the entire SKINLONGEVITY line. The Cleanser is a pearly white and true to the name a very soft cushiony feel. It doesn't lather a ton, but works in effectively cleansing without stripping any natural oils from my face. Overall, its a pretty good gentle cleanser to use.

This cleanser is okay. I don't feel like it gets as foamy as it should. Its more of a runny texture. My skin does feel nice after using it though. Its also gentle on my skin. *I received this in exchange for my honest review*
I'm impressed well how smooth this product has left my skin. It works very well and l plan to add it to my daily routine.

I really miss the Pure Plush cleanser. This new cleanser doesn't make my face as clean. I feel like you have to use so much of it to even get a nice lather. Why make a new product when the old was fantastic. Ugh!
Used Bareminerals skin longevity feels like a cloud.. never used a product like that before.. made my face feel so soft and felt so clean..
The cleanser feels like mousse and left my face smooth and refreshed. The only negative is that it might be a bit too much exfoliant,so I recommend to only use it twice a week

The cleanser has a light texture it feels like a mousse, it makes a mild foaming when applied on wet skin and leaves the feeling of a clean skin without leaving the skin dry. There's literally no scent on it and only a little bit of product is enough to get the job done.

I usually use any face wash but I definitely loved the consistency of this one. It felt like a marshmallowy foam that felt gentle to the skin. I really liked that about this cleanser. I also loved that my skin felt really clean and smooth after use.

I was really impressed by this cleanser. I have pretty sensitive, dry skin and this did a great job of making my skin feel clean but not stripped. It sort of reminded me of Tula's cleanser but my skin felt much more hydrated. Love and will purchase again.

I like it's pearly appearance, very pretty. It had a pleasant scent, and felt really nice and smooth on my face. However, it feels like it strips my face too much, and makes my face feel a little tight. Like when I'm rinsing it off of my face, it makes the friction between my face and hands feel squeaky.

I really miss the PurePlush cleanser BareMinerals used to make. This new cleanser is watery, doesn't foam, does a poor job of cleaning foundation off skin, and has caused my rosacea to flare up. I will not be buying it again.

I have to admit that i'm not big on facial cleansers. At least I haven't been in the past, but this face cleanser is a game changer. It feels luxurious against my skin and i can feel and see the difference after using this cleanser. I feel like it gives my skin a deeper clean, and that's why I love it so much! I've never had to go to cleanser before now, but this one will be it from now on. I'm totally obsessed and I highly recommend it!!!!
I have very sensitive skin and this cleanser did not irritate my skin at all. It's gentle and smells good. Works great!!

I found this foaming facial cleanser to be perfectly fine—it did the job and left my skin feeling clean and refreshed. That said, I didn't notice a significant difference compared to other similar brands I've tried. What stood out most was the packaging—it's sleek and looks great on the counter. Overall, a solid option, but not particularly unique.
I love this cleanser! It left my skin feeling very nourished and hydrated. Over time my skin has felt softer and smoother, I will definitely repurchase and try items from the rest of the line!

This is a great cream to foam cleanser. It starts out as a thick and luxurious cream, but then turns to foam. It removes makeup and sunscreen but rinses off easily and left my skin smoother & more nourished just after a couple of days. Within a week, my face was softer, smoother and moisturized.

Thanks BareMinerals for the free cleanser! I liked this cleanser, but I wasn't particularly wowed by it. Unlike other reviewers, I don't need or care if my cleanser foams up, so long as it does its job. This cleanser left my skin feeling "squeaky clean," but amazingly, it didn't dry it out. It wasn't great at removing makeup, but I usually use other products for that. It is a fine cleanser, though I'm not certain I would buy it to use again.
I liked this product. I wish it did foam just a little bit more than what it does however it helps my skin a lot. Overall a really great product and I would definitely buy it again.

I personally didn't really care for this cleanser, the texture was a bit off and it honestly felt like it was drying out my skin more than hydrating it, I didn't notice and immediate difference unfortunately.

I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review and feedback- all opinions are my own. I tried the Bare Minerals Skinlongevity Cushion Cloud Foaming Cleanser daily for over a two week period. I used the cleanser twice a day- in the morning and at night. This is a great cream to foam cleanser. It starts out as a thick and luxurious cream, but then turns to foam. It removes makeup and sunscreen but rinses off easily and left my skin smoother & more nourished just after a couple of days. The mineral herb complex definitely seemed to strengthen my skin's barrier bc after the two weeks, my skin was clearer and brighter.
I really wanted to like this but my skin is already somewhat dry and I feel like when I use this right after it completely dries out my face and makes it dull
Great product! Very little to no scent at all. It foams nicely. Left nice clean texture afterwards with no sticky residue or dry feeling. Highly recommend!

The name says it all…this gentle foaming cleanser literally feels as soft and light as a cloud, while at the same time, has the strength and power to remove makeup and sunscreen. A tiny bit of this cleanser goes a long way, as the cleanser lathers nicely. I have very sensitive and breakout prone slime, and this product did not irritate my skin at all. In fact, my skin was left clean and moisturized with this product. I highly recommend this product and will be trying other products in the SKINLONGEVITY line as I was so pleased with the cleanser!

Very easy to use and leaves a glow to my skin post use! This cleanser removes every drop of makeup, sunscreen and environmental pollutants left behind after a long day without my skin feeling stripped. I will be purchasing for myself when my gifted full-size sample runs out. Thank you bareMinerals and a BIG THANK YOU as always to BzzAgent for including me in another wonderful and exciting campaign!
This is the best cleanser. It is truly fluffy like a cloud and takes off, make up easily without drying out my skin. The formula is incredible! Highly recommend

I've been genuinely impressed with this face wash. I have sensitive skin, and very rarely stray from my trusted skincare routine. I took a chance on this product because I've had success with Bare Minerals in the past, and this product didn't disappoint! The face wash is light and airy, and lathers into a rich foam. My skin is left feeling clean, but not dry and tight. It doesn't cause any irritation or rosacea flare ups for me, which is obviously a huge bonus.

I received the sample in return for an honest review. I used this product for about one week. I can honestly say I did not like it. Every time I wash my face, it left a filmy feeling on my skin. Almost as if I couldn't rinse it off all the way. I have used other products that I was able to rinse off and not feel like something is left on my skin. After the third day, I noticed I had a couple of breakouts on my chin. I continued to use the product. By the end of the week I had even more breakouts on my chin. This is not normally something I have. I have not broke out in a very long time like this. I really had high hopes for this product because I love the Bare Minerals brand. I do think that I am not an ideal user for this product.

I suffer from very dry skin, regardless of weather and decided to try something new because my old cleanser wasn't cutting it. Within a week, my face was softer, smoother and moisturized. This has a faint but refreshing scent that doesn't linger on your skin. This will be my new cleanser moving forward.

Im loving this cleanser. The texture is amazing, it starts off like a creamy mousse and turns into the softest, cloud like foam. It feels so gentle and silky on my skin, never drying or harsh. The light herbal scent is super refreshing and not overpowering at all. I have sensitive skin and this has been a total game-changer. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a luxurious but gentle daily cleanser!

avis.titre: Leaves face feeling really clean and looking bright
avis.texte: I received bareMinerals Skin longevity cushion cloud gentle foam cleaner from bzzagent for free in exchange for my honest review. This bareMinerals Skin longevity Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser is one of my new favorite face washes. It's has a rich and creamy feel to the product. This bareMinerals cleanser creates a nice lather when washing my face. It leaves my face feeling clean and purified. I also noticed immediately after using my face looks brighter and smoother. It has became one of my favorites and I am planning on buying some when I run out.

This cleanser really left my skin feeling smooth and rejuvenated. The rough patches were smoothed and my skin felt soft and ready for serums and moisturizer! A great beginning g to my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Amazing Product - PERFECT Moisturizer as well
avis.texte: Moisturizes the skin well while washing it thoroughly. It takes more than one wash to properly remove the makeup but I wash my face more than once when I remove my makeup so it works well for me. I would recommend this product to a friend as well as repurchase it for myself as well. It is friendly with my sensitive skin, as well.

This cleanser comes in an attractive and functional bottle. The cleanser comes out as a liquid and lathers nicely when rubbed onto the face or in between hands. It leaves skin feeling clean, refreshed and moisturized! Very happy with this product
I love how my skin feels after using this cleanser daily for month. Just a little bit of product really goes a long way! Would definitely recommend!!

I've been using the Skinlongevity® Cushion Cloud Foaming Cleanser for about two weeks now every morning and evening. The cream-to-foam formula feels light and luxurious—gentle on the skin and not at all stripping. It rinses clean and leaves my face feeling soft and hydrated. It does a solid job removing daily sunscreen and light makeup. I noticed my skin felt brighter and more balanced after just one use. I don't experience any tightness or irritation—perfect for sensitive areas. A clinical study notes 100% of users found it non‑irritating after just one day of use.

The SKINLONGEVITY Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser is a soft, creamy face wash from bareMinerals. It gently cleans your skin without making it feel dry or tight. It's made for daily use and works well if you have oily or combination skin. It helps remove dirt, sunscreen, and light makeup, and is fragrance-free and gentle. Overall, it's a good everyday cleanser if you want something gentle and easy on your skin.
This cleanser is so gentle and leaves your face feeling refreshed! Did not cause me to break out, little to no scent! My sister tried and loves it too! Definitely would recommend!
This product made my skin feel so soft. I have acne prone skin and this helped control it. I would buy this over and over.

I've been using the Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser twice a day for about 3 weeks. What I love: the texture is somewhere between a cream and a foam and it feels so lovely on my skin. The product squeezes out easily from the bottle and I like the "upside-down" bottle so I feel like I'll actually be able to get all the product out when I'm close to the end. The cleanser doesn't have any discernible fragrance and didn't trigger my allergies. What I don't love so much: This cleanser gives my skin that "squeaky-clean" feeling, as though I still have product left on my face, but rubbing it harder doesn't make the soap scum feeling go away. I also think this product is sold at a price point that doesn't necessarily reflect it's quality; I do believe I have achieved similar results with drugstore face washes. Bottom Line: I'd recommend this to people who are a fan of that squeaky clean feeling (i.e. dove soap) and who can fit this luxury product into their budget.

I am a big fan of Bare Minerals, but up until now, I have only used their makeup products. This line of skin care is sooo good. The thing I love the most is how it doesn't know you over with smells. NO SMELL AT ALL. Also, a tiny bit of this goes a long way. About a dime size amount foams up just like the name- like a cushiony cloud! Now let's talk about how amazing my face feels after using this cleanser! So soft and smooth. I will definitely be switching my cleanser to this one, and I highly suggest you give it a try. You will be hooked too! It doesn't matter that I rev this product from a campaign to try for free, because I honestly love it!

avis.titre: It's like a cushion for your skin.
avis.texte: This product. THIS PRODUCT. The only thing I've found that is even remotely similar in comparison, came from my personalized skincare routine from a subscription service. This cleanser is a godsend. It's light, creamy, it foams up brilliantly, leaving skin feeling incredibly clean, refreshed, and moisturized. It has a pleasant scent that is VERY minimal, so it would be okay for even the girlies who are incredibly sensitive to smells. It's incredible and I will buy it again and again!

I'm pretty loyal to my skincare regiment. I sometimes try out new things but tend to go back to my tried and true products. I've been using the same couple face cleansers for years now, never really felt the need to change. But I recently received this cleanser and omg I LOVE it! The texture is so oddly satisfying. And my face feels so refreshed and clean, but still so moisturized! It's like a clarifying and ultra moisturizing cleanser all in one. I will absolutely be purchasing this consistently from now on and replacing my usual daily cleanser. I'm in love with this one and so glad I got to try it!
Overall a really nice cleanser. It foams up nicely and cleanses the skin well without stripping it of moisture.

This cleanser comes as a soft cream that becomes a gentle foam when you apply it to your face. It leaves my skin feeling clean but not stripped and tight. The product does not have a fragrance and it did not break me out. You only need a small dollop so I can see this lasting me a long time.

avis.titre: This is a permanent part of my daily routine!
avis.texte: I use this everyday and it makes my skin feel so soft and smooth. It is a great addition to my skin care routine. I have sensitive skin and it works absolutely amazing for me.
This was a great cleanser and I would definitely recommend to my friends and family. This is such a super lightweight product and makes your skin feel soft right after using.

I will start from when I put it in my hand. You do not need much. You can feel the creaminess of it just from the start. When I put it on my face, it has a clean, non-frangrance smell. The minute I put it on, it feels soft and easy to use. It makes my skin feel clean and moisturized. Not harsh or stripped like some do.

avis.titre: A Gentle Cleanser That Truly Delivers!
avis.texte: I've tried a lot of facial cleansers over the years, at every level of price and this cleanser really stands out. Compared to others that I've used, this one feels incredibly gentle yet effective — it removes makeup and impurities without stripping my skin or leaving it tight and dry. One of the biggest benefits is how soft and hydrated my skin feels after using it. The foam feels luxurious and soothing, and it's perfect for my irritable skin. I would absolutely buy this product again. It's now a regular part of my skincare routine, and I love knowing it's clean, cruelty-free, and made with skin-loving ingredients. If you're looking for a gentle but effective cleanser that smells and feels like a mini spa treatment, this is it.

I received this product free to review, I do remember Bare Minerals from the early 2000's and even had some of their makeup. I was incredibly excited to be chosen to try this product and it did not disappoint! It is unscented, it is a thick and creamy consistency and it lathers up very nicely. I used this morning and night and noticed plumper, less dehydrated skin in a week. I want to try the rest of the line now since this face wash is a game changer! I've never used a face wash that left my skin feeling moisturized and soft, normally my face wash leaves my skin dry and begging for moisture. I have combination skin and this face wash worked beautifully for me.
I love how this worked for me. The cleanser was non stripping and left my skin feeling smooth after using it. I liked how it bubbled up too.

I have noticed an improvement in my skins overall texture after only a few weeks of using this cleanser. It is gentle for every day use and lathers nicely. My skin feels super clean and soft afterwards. It even helps take off stubborn mascara. The product has a light smell.

I've been using this product as my daily cleanser and it's been great. It's SUPER moisturizing which has been great during this summer heat wave and has helped keep my skin from drying out as usual. Love that it doesn't leave any residue or sticky feeling on my face after being washed off.

I have loved trying this new facial cleanser. As someone with sensitive skin, it's difficult to find cleansers are gentle enough for me. But this cleanser is amazing and my skin tolerates it well! It leaves my skin feeling soft and glowy after each use. If you're thinking about buying this product, trust me, just get it! You won't be disappointed.

I received this product to try for free. This was a fantastic cleanser. I loved how squeaky clean it made my face feel after washing without feeling tight. I will definitely be purchasing this product!!

I want to preface this with I never give a 5 star review of anything unless I absolutely adore it and would be sad without it. But overall I do like this cleanser and I have sensitive skin and this made my skin feel so good and clean and soft. Idk how else to word it but that way. I didnt break out like I have for so many other cleansers and thats a plus in my book.

I did like the way it made my skin feel but it was not visibly brighter or saw an immediate change as advertised. Overall I would probably buy it in the future to see how it truly works with consistent use.

I received this as a sample for a review. This is a great cleanser. It's rich and creamy and still cleanses. This doesn't leave my skin feeling dried out. I still feel moisturized and as I age, this is becoming more and more important. I would definitely buy this again. It cleanses and moisturizes.

I have used this product over the last few weeks and must say that it is now part of my everyday routine. I used it to gentle clean my face as well as to promove make-up. It gives a really nice clean that does not strip my skin.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I use the *SKINLONGEVITY® Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser* morning and night, and it's quickly become a favorite. The texture is soft and airy, and it lathers into a creamy foam that feels luxurious on the skin. It cleanses thoroughly without drying or irritating, even on my sensitive skin. My face always feels refreshed and balanced after using it. The only downside is that the tube can be a little tricky to squeeze as it starts to empty—but the formula is worth it. A little goes a long way!

This cleanser smells great and leaves my oily face not oily but also not dried out. Usually if a cleanser helps my oily skin it leaves it super dry and flaky. I've been washing my face with this cleanser every morning and every other evening and it's fantastic. Definitely recommend!

The cleanser was so creamy and had no harsh perfume smell. The lather is subtle but feels so moisturizing and doesn't leave your skin feeling stripped of all its natural oils. It makes your skin feel so soft and clean. Perfect for a natural and nourishing clean feeling face!

I am loving using this foaming cleanser! It is soothing and leaves my skin feeling moisturized and clean. I've been on the look out for a new face wash that achieves those things without my skin feeling stripped. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Creamy, Smooth and Perfection in One Bottle
avis.texte: Love how smooth this product is with application. Helps keep my combination skin clean and problematic free. Doesn't strip the oils from my face and leave it feeling dry after product use.

avis.titre: If you like the makeup, you're gonna like this!
avis.texte: This is a pretty good basic cleanser. It is maybe a little lighter feeling than others, a tad thinner than I expected it to be. The cleanser itself is very pretty, shimmery and pearly white. The smell is mild, but reminds me of the smell of makeup foundation or moisturizer. It could smell better. This product DID make my skin soft, and appear more even. It also gave my skin a slight glow/brightening effect. I feel like if you dont use it every day, the effect fades quickly. If used every day I feel like this is a great product that does what it says it will do. I would recommend this to a friend that wants brighter and softer skin, and I would buy this for myself as well. *I recieved this product for free, in exchange for this review.*
I love using this as my daily gentle cleanser, it's lightweight but effective. It has a great lather and my face feels clean without using a lot of product.

I enjoyed using the bareMinerals skinlongevity cushion cloud foaming cleanser. It feels gentle on the skin. It has a pleasant scent that is not overwhelming. It lathers nicely and doesn't dry out my skin. It gives a nice foam cleaning.

I have relatively sensitive skin and this has been miraculous for my face. I have noticed softer, plump, and better looking skin after using this cleanser. I love the consistency of the product and look forward to washing my face each morning. It doesn't strip my natural oils and leaves me feel very refreshed. Will absolutely recommend to anyone!
not for oily skin. My skin is oily and when I wash with it makes more oily at my Tzone. Got this product free at Bzzagent

avis.titre: Great Product for the right skin type
avis.texte: I received bareMinerals Skin Longevity Cushion Cloud Foaming Cleanser as a sample product to review and it has a lot of great features and could be a good and gentle cleanser for people without acne prone skin I believe. I personally need something with either benzoyl peroxide or glycolic acid to keep my acne at bay so I noticed that my face started to break out a few days after using it because I think my skin needs an acne fighting ingredient to be in my cleanser. This cleanser has a great texture and did foam up really nicely. It has a very clean feel and the packaging is really beautiful and simple as well. It doesn't have any scent, I personally prefer some scent to my facial products but I know a lot of people don't so that is a pro as well.

I have been looking for more "mature" skin care products and I was happy to try this one out! The cushion cloud foaming cleanser was gentle on my skin. It left my skin feeling tighter and smoother without making it feel dried out. Very easy to use and had no harsh smell or side effects to me.

I received the SKINLONGEVITY® Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser in exchange for my honest review. This cleanser has a rich, creamy texture that feels more like a cream cleanser than a foaming one—it didn't foam much for me, but I actually enjoyed that. It left my skin feeling hydrated and soft, without any greasy residue. Overall, I love how gentle and nourishing it is, and I would definitely recommend it!
The formula isn't too heavy and the lather is great. After using it my skin feels dewy and has a fresh feeling to it. A small amount goes a long way.

I used this product in the shower and at night on my face. The scent was good. Not overwhelming. The foaming was nice but I felt I could never get it off my face fully. Seemed to clean my face well and never made it dry but not moisturizing either. The consistency was off and I did not like it.

It was creamy consistency and it didn't take a large amount to clean my entire face. The first time I used it, my face felt tight and dry. I didn't experience that any of the subsequent times I used it but I also didn't see a huge difference in my skin. I didn't notice my face feeling more moisturized although it does feel softer. I'm not sure I would buy it. I received a sample in exchange for my review.

I use this cleanser for removing my face makeup in the evenings and it works wonders. It is light and doesn't have any harsh smells, but most importantly it removes all the residue from my face. I like the foam over a gel or cream as its easy to apply. You don't even feel the product when it's applied. It doesn't break out my skin or cause dryness, which is a huge positive.
It left my skin feeling so smooth. Not like other products that make my skin sticky.

avis.titre: I will be adding this to my skincare routine.
avis.texte: I haven't used this product very long, but so far I am liking it. Leaves my skin soft and smooth and I like the consistency of the cleanser. I won't be replacing my current cleanser because I need benzoyl peroxide but I will be using this 1-2x a week. I received this for free in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this again!
avis.texte: bareMinerals Skin Longevity Cushion Cloud Foaming Cleanser worked wonders on my 50+ skin. I have used many cleansers in my adult life and I must say that I was pleasantly surprised with how soft this cleanser left my face. It is a stunning pearlescent white and takes a little less than a dime size to lather beautifully on your face and neck. It rinses clean and leaves your skin feeling amazing. I have recommended it to my friends, which is something I don't do on a regular basis.

I've been using this face wash for the past month and it is amazing. I have sensitive skin and this causes no irritation and does a great job of cleansing. It feels lightweight but i can see a difference in my skin.

I used this product in the morning so I cannot comment as to its ability to remove makeup. I applied the product on a slightly dampened face and it sort of stuck in places on my face instead of foaming up and it was not really spreadable. It did end up rinsing and cleansing nicely but just felt weird during use.

This cleanser seems to be pretty okay. After about a week of use, I haven't found any irritation on my skin. At the same time I am not noticing any improvement to my skin either. It doesn't look brighter or more even.

I received Cushion Cloud Foaming Cleanser as a sample to try and review. The consistency is lovely. This is a great addition to my daily routine. The cleanser is moisturizing and glides easily across my skin. It completely removed a days worth of makeup and dirt. It washes away without leaving a sticky residue or your skin feeling dry. My only critique is the tube is the same height and shape as my toothpaste which could lead to an interesting mistake!

I like this cleanser, it is creamy and hydrating. It lathers well and cleans without leaving my face feeling dry and tight. I like the addition of minerals and herbs. I like having a gentle cream cleanser especially since I use retinol which can causing flaking and dryness. Does not have a strong or unpleasant scent. Overall I like it.

avis.titre: I would buy this product every time
avis.texte: I love that skinlongevity is light and not heavy on my skin. Pleasant scent not strong. Leaves my skin feeling refreshed and soft and awake. I love that it rinses clean and doesn't leave a sticky feeling or greasy feeling on my skin. The foam is so easy to use. I love it. I have already recommended to my family and friends!!!!
I love how it cleans my face. And after, my skin feels so smooth. I have noticed my skin looks brighter.
I wanted to like it but I think there's an ingredient in it that gave me a reaction. It gave me a rash and I took q few days off of it and tried it again and same thing happened

I was sent this product in exchange for my honest review and opinions. This product has a great texture, nice smell and good consistency. My skin is mixed, leaning more towards oily. The wash did not break my skin out, however it seemed a bit too moisturizing for my skin, as I had an oily face within a few hours after using.
I love this foaming cleanser. Easy to use, soft, gentle, great scent. I would definitely recommend it!

I loved the Cushion Cloud Cleanser! It feels super soft going on, foams up nicely, and leaves my skin clean without any dryness. My face feels fresh, smooth, and never irritated. Great for daily use, and a little goes a long way. Definitely a new favorite!
This cleanser feels wonderful on my skin and has the perfect balance of clean feeling and soft. My skin feels so smooth after using and it doesn't irritate my skin at all!

The bareminerals skinlongevity cushion cloud gentle foaming cleanser is my new favorite! The smooth, creamy texture is thick and foams easily to ensure a good lather. Bareminerals continues to create some of the BEST products and this line an absolute win. I love the mineral herb complex in this product, the best foaming cleanser.

I received a sample of bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY Cushion Cloud Foaming Cleanser to sample and review, and I was excited to try their skincare since I love their makeup products. On the plus side it is a lightweight foaming cleanser that does an excellent job of removing dirt and makeup and it left my skin squeaky clean. Unfortunately it also left it feeling tight - uncomfortably tight - and dry. It was so uncomfortable I had to use my heavy winter moisturizer to try to counteract the dryness. I think if you have oily skin this may work better, unfortunately it didn't work for me.

This is a great, gentle cleanser that didn't irritate my skin at all. I love that it's fragrance free and I don't have to worry about any harsh ingredients. The only drawback I experienced is that my face never felt completely clean, even after double-cleansing. Overall, I think this is a great cleanser for someone whose skin needs a break, but you might need to pair it with a makeup remover if you're someone who (like me), wears a lot of makeup.

I received this as part of a promotion. I like the texture and that it is unscented. It's leaves your skin feeling clean and not tight or dry. I would use this in the morning vs at night since it didn't remove all of my makeup, even with double cleansing.

I've been using the BareMinerals Skinlongevity Cleanser for a few weeks now and I'm genuinely impressed. I have sensitive skin, and this cleanser is incredibly gentle—no irritation, dryness, or redness at all. It has a light, refreshing texture that cleanses thoroughly while leaving my skin soft, smooth, and balanced. I also love the subtle, clean scent—it's not overpowering. A little goes a long way, making it great value for the quality. Highly recommend for anyone, especially those with sensitive skin!

Love this cleanser! A small amount goes a long way to clean your face! The texture wasn't too greasy ! I love how soft/smoother and clean my face felt after using the product ! Other products that I've tired would have to go into my bottle at least 2-3 to have my face completely clean! But with this product i did not have to apply a lot to feel my face clean. I will definitely be buying again once I am done with the bottle! Definitely recommend family friends z!
This face wash is so amazing it makes my skin feel and looks great and the product is thick but light and doesn't over dry it's super rich and luxurious. I love it

avis.titre: Lovely texture but less foamy than expected
avis.texte: (I received this product in exchange for my honest review.) I've been using this cleanser for a couple of weeks and overall it is a lovely product. I can see why they named it cushion cloud- it looks like a soft cloud when it comes out of the bottle. I will say, for a foaming cleanser, it really does not get very foamy.. but that doesn't bother me. It leaves my skin feeling almost too clean, in a stripped way, but I don't believe it has caused any dryness. Overall, the cleanser is nice and I will continue to use it, but I don't know that I would repurchase.

This new cleanser works very well and I'm impressed by the outcome, however I really liked their previous Pure Plush better as you needed less product for one application. It is very light and smells amazing, love it!

avis.titre: Not a fan - Wouldn't purchase again
avis.texte: I, personally didn't like the Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser. The reason being, I felt like it left my skin feeling like there was a oil layer left after washing my face. I tried the face wash multiple times and experienced the same issue.

Overall good cleanser. I have not used the previous Plush Cleaners so I cannot compare the new formula to the old- but I used this mostly at night to wash the face after removing makeup. Feels lightweight on the skin and lathers nicely but leaves a silk like feeling afterwards. Not sure how I feel about that. Formula seems to be good, would recommend to try it out.

I've been using bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY for a little while now, and I'm really impressed! The formula is lightweight yet hydrating, and it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, which is perfect for my combination skin. My skin feels softer and looks more radiant, and I've noticed a subtle improvement in texture and smoothness. I also love that it has a mild, fresh scent that isn't overpowering—perfect for sensitive skin. The packaging is sleek and practical, which adds a nice touch.

I received this product right before my July 4th vacation. I ended up not reapplying enough sun screen on my face and burned a bit. With this awesomely moisturizing cleanser, I feel it helped heal my face bit faster than with my regular after sun routine! Feels like creamy butter going on with luscious bubbles. It didnt leave my skin feeling tight or dried out whatsoever. If anything it helped keep my face moisturized.

I received this SKINLONGEVITY Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser free from BzzAgent and BareMinerals in exchange for my honest review. This effectively removed my makeup without stripping away moisture. I was a little rosy the first couple minutes after using but that subsided.

I loved the SKINLONGEVITY® Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser! It has a light, fresh scent and foams nicely with water to gently cleanse your face. It feels nourishing and refreshing and leaves my face feeling very clean. I love that it's made with an all natural mineral herb complex, and is vegan, cruelty free, and devoid of artificial fragrances. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

This gentle foaming cleanser feels like a soft cloud on the skin, it's very light and effective. It removes impurities without making your face feel tight and dry. My skin feel clean, smooth, and refreshed after each use.

I received a full size of the Bareminerals Skinlongevity Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser for free in exchange for my opinion and a review of the product. I'll start with saying that I'm a double cleanser and have been for years. No matter how effective a cleanser claims to be, I just don't feel like my face is clean at night without double cleansing. So, this is how I used the product - after an oil first cleanse. I genuinely liked the product. I go back & forth between a glycerin based foaming cleanser and a very gentle lotion cleanser. This was the perfect in between. I got a nice foam, but the cleanser did not leave my skin dry or tight afterwards. I did not notice any scent and the packaging was nice & not messy. I prefer a tube to pump for getting all of the product out without waste. I'm not sure if I'll repurchase, only because there are other cleansers on the market that I like just as much at a lower cost. But this product did the job and I had a nice experience while using.

avis.titre: Leaves your face feeling soft and clean
avis.texte: Bare Minerals Skinlongevity Cushion cloud foaming face wash is a silky soap. It foams up with just a small amount of water. After risning your face your face feels soft and clean. You only need a the size of a pea to clean your face because a little bit goes a long way.

I was excited to review this product for free from Buzzagent. I have been using this product morning and night for 10 days. I have dry sensitive skin that is often red. The consistency was more cream than foaming. It foamed just a little bit. It was gentle on my skin. From day 1, my face appeared less red and more bright. The brightness didn't last long though. I do think it hydrated and cleaned well. It didn't have that tight feeling afterwards that some cleaners do. I did have a few more breakouts during these 10 days, but it could be hormonal. Overall, I liked the product and would buy again.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. The Skinlongevity line has always worked rather well for me so I was excited to try a new one. The cleanser is extremely gentle and does feel like a plush foam so I get the Cushion cloud name. I don't notice a distinct fragrance but it smells like a hint of a fresh herb-y scent. I do feel it has been helpful in calming irritated skin and possibly healing my skin barrier but I haven't noticed any huge changes in texture or brightness of my skin. I'd say this is a great gentle option if you have sensitized skin or need something to help support your skin barrier but I don't think it's anything particularly special for anything else. I'd assume you may see more of those benefits with the serum from this line.
Omg i love love love it. It rinse off all the oil on my face but gentle enough to not dry out my skin. Definitely buy it again

This product is for someone looking for clean ingredients. I got this free to test. The packaging is very cute but I couldn't differentiate it much otherwise. A good basic cleanser I will use but would not necessarily seek it out. Wasn't a big fan of the scent or lack of.
